novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a dynamic mechanism and measurement: it proposes that an LLM “silently disambiguates to a single interpretation early,” while a “hidden-state branch-diversity signature” predicts that collapse and can be steered to keep alternatives active. Searches using “LLM ambiguity parallel interpretations hidden states,” “premature disambiguation branch maintenance,” “garden-path incremental semantic interpretation LLM,” and “ambiguity steering neurons” identify Incremental Comprehension of Garden-Path Sentences by Large Language Models (2024) as the closest work because it already measures dynamic semantic interpretations and implicit parse shifts around disambiguation; The LM Understood the Prompt was Ambiguous and Are Larger Language Models Better at Disambiguation? provide additional close precedent for tracking competing syntactic readings and resolution failures. Extending these lines to per-step branch counts across lexical, syntactic, and scope ambiguity is a natural but non-trivial integration, while the pre-output hidden-state branch-diversity trajectory and its causal maintenance constitute a new operational relationship rather than merely a changed dataset; because probing, continuation clustering, and activation steering are themselves standard tools, this supports standard rather than high novelty.
